broeringluke: Roland "Doc" Broeringluke arrived on Day 5 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

The barrage caught Roland "Doc" Broeringluke in the open at S-S10. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. The shell that hit S-S10 took Roland "Doc" Broeringluke with it. No stretcher, no surgeon, no last words. Just the crater.

Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke put a cracked shaving mirror beside the bunk. Someone who had known Roland "Doc" Broeringluke helped clear the shelf without saying why. Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke won before reaching the end of his entry.
Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it.
Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Quentin Stefan, was grazed. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-S10 changed before the cheering ended. Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke shouldered another load.

The corporal found out Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke used to be a carpenter. Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke has been doing two jobs ever since. The clerk counted the names twice. Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke is number 361 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Marek Jackmdunn was grazed.
Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke lost a boot in the trench. Casimir Singh found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke wrote a letter for Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade's mother, because Doc could not find the words. Doc signed it.
Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke fired at a movement across the wire at S-S10. The man went down: Ivo "Smokes" Fox, badly wounded.
Dawn watch. Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Silas Caydan, grazed.
Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-S10. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Quentin "Doc" Pbscn of the Concord (@pbscn_).
bucket_hat_pat_: The new rifleman is Jonas Pat, once a lamplighter from Ashford Vale. The corporal asked if a lamplighter was any use in a trench. Jonas Pat said he would find out.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Jonas Pat wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A newspaper reached Jonas Pat with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Jonas Pat watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Jonas Pat added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Jonas Pat spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor (Hegemony) and Jonas Pat (Concord) watched each other through the same loophole at Saint-Ash crossroads for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Jonas Pat won before reaching the end of his entry.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Jonas Pat was hit hard in the fight at T-F19 before anyone could fire. The raider was Albin Welcometomem of the Hegemony. Raider: Albin Welcometomem of the Hegemony (@welcometomemetown2.0).
Jonas Pat's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed.
davebowlton: Walter Davebowlton came up on Day 9 carrying news from Ashford Vale. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Walter Davebowlton went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Concord trench a man turned around too late. Gideon "Ghost" Marks did not get up again. (@marks89kk) Walter Davebowlton went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Yann Vylet was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@simon_vylet) Walter Davebowlton walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Walter Davebowlton had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Gideon "Shadow" Eight, grazed. Walter Davebowlton saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-C12 and fired once. Benedikt Urasmrl was badly wounded. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Walter Davebowlton answered to number 890. Grey Mill has been won. Walter Davebowlton listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

The gun crews at R-C12 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Anselm Rakan was grazed. Walter Davebowlton swept the enemy parapet at R-C12 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Dietrich "Spark" Domgas was grazed.
Walter Davebowlton brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
A note came over the wire at the Hanging Bridge, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Hegemony. Signed, Silas Wwjd.' Walter Davebowlton sang louder.
Two men fed the belt while Walter Davebowlton held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale was grazed.
Walter Davebowlton rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Isidor Jro was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Walter Davebowlton received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
frank_mart00: At the depot, Matthias Mart had practised answering to his name. At R-F7, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A child had enclosed a riddle in a parcel for Matthias Mart. The answer was on the back. He kept the dugout guessing until supper. Verdel Ridge has been won. Matthias Mart listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Matthias Mart asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.

On a quiet night Matthias Mart (Concord) and Ulrich Jwessels (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. A letter from home found Matthias Mart before the night shift. Matthias Mart folded it small and kept it close.

Matthias Mart went out with the wiring party at R-F7. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Matthias Mart stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Matthias Mart traded a tin whistle for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
Dawn watch. Matthias Mart put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Casimir Sky, badly wounded.
Matthias Mart found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a woman in a white dress, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
Matthias Mart measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.

At R-F7 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Matthias Mart turned around and took a shovel blow. Konrad Dorf of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Konrad Dorf of the Hegemony (@hunter_dorf0629). The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-F7. Matthias Mart has learned to walk bent double.

A bullet struck Matthias Mart below the ribs at R-F7. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Ivo "Bones" Rylan of the Hegemony (@rylan_45h). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Matthias Mart fell at R-F7 and never moved again. Shot by Ivo "Bones" Rylan of the Hegemony (@rylan_45h).

Felix "Whistle" Mart came to the front because his father Matthias Mart never came home. He carries a tin whistle. The clerk counted the names twice. Felix "Whistle" Mart is number 125 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. After the loss of Grey Mill, Felix "Whistle" Mart helped stack spare sandbags at R-F7. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Felix "Whistle" Mart and Zeno "Hollow" Batman share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.

Felix "Whistle" Mart was hit through the stomach at R-F7. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Casimir "Saint" Bevis of the Hegemony (@bevis.44). Felix "Whistle" Mart was killed at R-F7 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Casimir "Saint" Bevis of the Hegemony (@bevis.44).
The papers say Norbert "Lucky" Mart. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Felix "Whistle" Mart's eyes. Nobody in R-F7 argues.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Norbert "Lucky" Mart has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
Lightning lit Grey Mill and Norbert "Lucky" Mart saw the enemy wire, the enemy trench, and a man in it looking straight back.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F7. Norbert "Lucky" Mart was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Zeno Hayden of the Hegemony (@hayden.dt).
Yann Mart joined R-F7 under the shadow of Norbert "Lucky" Mart's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

A bullet went into Yann Mart's chest just under the heart at R-F7. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Arno "Shadow" Meloche of the Hegemony (@jeremie_laval_meloche). Yann Mart looked over the parapet at R-F7 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Arno "Shadow" Meloche of the Hegemony (@jeremie_laval_meloche).
Konrad Mart took the same post at R-F7 where Yann Mart stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
lancegribko: The old hands of R-F22 have been here since Day 1. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko has been here since Day 4. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.

Wiring party. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at R-F22, and everyone came back. Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Kesselby. Every version sounded like the ration bell. Mail came up the line with a letter for Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The shelling stopped while Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko and Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.

A bullet hit Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko's belt buckle at R-F22 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Arno Coopergfulto of the Concord (@coopergfulton).

Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko returned to R-F22 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Asked what he wanted after the war, Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on. The clerk counted the names twice. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko is number 293 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-F22. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko fired at the last man to run. Dorian Media was grazed.
Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko of the Hegemony and Edmund Arvidgrubb of the Concord have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at the Brickworks. It is getting crowded.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.

Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Walter Snixx, badly wounded. On dawn watch at R-F22, Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Dietrich Zaza, now grazed.

Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Anselm "Saint" Davis was badly wounded. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko ate breakfast without a word. The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko waited for that to change. When it did, Dorian Media was gravely wounded.

Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Otto Dmcm was badly wounded. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Gideon "Owl" Snixx was grazed.
owenhart247: Felix "Bones" Owenhart reached S-F13 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
Felix "Bones" Owenhart was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F13 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
Felix "Bones" Owenhart sharpened a pencil with great care and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Felix "Bones" Owenhart helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Felix "Bones" Owenhart fired at a movement across the wire at S-F13. The man went down: Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta, badly wounded.

Felix "Bones" Owenhart was hit through the chest at S-F13. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony (@heheheha1939). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Felix "Bones" Owenhart fell at S-F13 and never moved again. Shot by Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony (@heheheha1939).

The papers connected Edmund Owenhart to Felix "Bones" Owenhart. The men took longer to learn Edmund Owenhart's own habits, but they made the effort. Volunteer number 75. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Edmund Owenhart's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'

A clear shot from S-F13. Edmund Owenhart gravely wounded Dorian Coletonmarti and slid back down below the parapet. After the loss of Hill 304, Edmund Owenhart helped stack spare sandbags at S-F13. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Edmund Owenhart spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
Edmund Owenhart found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Edmund Owenhart fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Gustav Coletonmarti, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.

A round came through the loophole Edmund Owenhart was watching at S-F13 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak). Edmund Owenhart borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Nils Axebozo was grazed. Edmund Owenhart was killed at S-F13 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak).

Zeno Owenhart asked about Edmund Owenhart on arriving at S-F13. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Zeno Owenhart was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.

Zeno Owenhart went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@josiascouper) Zeno Owenhart jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Ulrich Zelenszki. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@_zelenszki_) Zeno Owenhart came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-F13. Zeno Owenhart has learned to walk bent double.

A medic brought Zeno Owenhart half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Zeno Owenhart wrote to a girl from the dance hall, maybe that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Nobody could reach Zeno Owenhart in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
Gideon "Shadow" Owenhart put a cracked shaving mirror beside the bunk. Someone who had known Zeno Owenhart helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Gideon "Shadow" Owenhart felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F13. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Benedikt "Button" Niarchos of the Hegemony (@niarchos_n).

Gideon "Shadow" Owenhart went out with the wiring party at S-F13. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Three days with a bandage, and Gideon "Shadow" Owenhart is back at S-F13. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
The storm put out the lamp twice. On the third attempt, Gideon "Shadow" Owenhart and two others formed a very irritated windbreak.

The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F13 they left Gideon "Shadow" Owenhart behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Ulrich Zelenszki of the Hegemony (@_zelenszki_).
The papers say Roland "Owl" Owenhart. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Gideon "Shadow" Owenhart's eyes. Nobody in S-F13 argues.

A bullet clipped Roland "Owl" Owenhart's helmet at S-F13 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Gustav "Crow" Slightlyreta of the Hegemony (@slightlyretarded69).
pridumay_sam_mne_vpadlu: The draft reached Q-F14 on Day 9. Ulrich "Owl" Vpadlu was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Ulrich "Owl" Vpadlu was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at Q-F14. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Dorian Itzwill of the Concord (@itzwill16). Ulrich "Owl" Vpadlu walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

The wound looked small. It was not. Ulrich "Owl" Vpadlu was carried back with a fever and a hand that would not stop shaking. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Ulrich "Owl" Vpadlu wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Ulrich "Owl" Vpadlu died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
The House of Vpadlu sent Zeno Vpadlu after Ulrich "Owl" Vpadlu. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Zeno Vpadlu offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.
On a quiet night Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr (Concord) and Zeno Vpadlu (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
Zeno Vpadlu was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at Q-F14. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Silas Mcgrail of the Concord (@patrick.t.mcgrail).
Zeno Vpadlu held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
Another member of the House of Vpadlu reached the line: Lucien Vpadlu. He asked where Zeno Vpadlu had slept, then chose a different corner.

A sniper's bullet hit Lucien Vpadlu at Q-F14. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft of the Concord (@brouwer_airsoft). Lucien Vpadlu has a bed in the hospital dugout at last, between a man who prays and a man who swears. He says it is a fair balance. Lucien Vpadlu is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger.
sanocfc: The new rifleman is Norbert Sanocfc, once a tailor from Halden. The corporal asked if a tailor was any use in a trench. Norbert Sanocfc said he would find out.

No rifles, only shovels and knives. Norbert Sanocfc dropped into the Concord trench by a dugout door and met Karel Punchworth coming out. It was over in seconds. (@lord_punchworth) Blackwater Canal has been won. Norbert Sanocfc listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Norbert Sanocfc's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Norbert Sanocfc helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
The village shop had three kinds of soap. Norbert Sanocfc stood at the counter far longer than the purchase required.
Norbert Sanocfc had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Pavel Wallstercorn was badly wounded.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Norbert Sanocfc's ear at S-R1 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Marek Janzhhhhhhhh of the Concord (@janzhhhhhhhhhh).
The wound Norbert Sanocfc shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more.
There was no room for Norbert Sanocfc. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
Zeno Sanocfc came to the front because his brother Norbert Sanocfc never came home. He carries a pocket Bible with a hole in it.
Zeno Sanocfc taught a recruit to recognize letters by sound. By supper, the whole table was tapping out Morse on the planks.
schradog2: Casimir Schradog arrived with the Day 3 draft, carrying his mother's thimble and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Casimir Schradog stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Casimir Schradog polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

Casimir Schradog borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'. A letter from home reached Casimir Schradog before dusk. Casimir Schradog read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Schradog went out with the wiring party at S-F6. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home reached Casimir Schradog before dusk. Casimir Schradog read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Casimir Schradog did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Casimir Schradog agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. A letter from home reached Casimir Schradog before dusk. Casimir Schradog read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Schradog fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Otto Commanderchr, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home reached Casimir Schradog before dusk. Casimir Schradog read it twice and slept a little easier.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Casimir Schradog aimed just below it. Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple was grazed. A letter from home reached Casimir Schradog before dusk. Casimir Schradog read it twice and slept a little easier.

The artist tried again while Casimir Schradog read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion. A letter from home reached Casimir Schradog before dusk. Casimir Schradog read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Schradog came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Casimir Schradog only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F6, then nothing but pain. Raider: Albin Belugawales of the Concord (@belugawales3). The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Casimir Schradog folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside. A letter from home reached Casimir Schradog before dusk. Casimir Schradog read it twice and slept a little easier.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Casimir Schradog is whole again, or near enough for the line. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Casimir Schradog answered to number 178. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Casimir Schradog watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Casimir Schradog smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Walter "Tin" Hansaazz came out for a cup and was grazed.
Casimir Schradog sent the portrait home after asking the artist to leave the ears alone. A photograph would have cost more than he could spare.

Casimir Schradog fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Rafael "Saint" Simplepach was grazed. A letter from home reached Casimir Schradog before dusk. Casimir Schradog read it twice and slept a little easier.

At S-F6 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Casimir Schradog won the bet. Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple was badly wounded. Casimir Schradog was hit through the stomach at S-F6. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Bram "Mud" Manningwam of the Concord (@manningwam). Casimir Schradog was killed at S-F6 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Bram "Mud" Manningwam of the Concord (@manningwam).
Walter "Parson" Schradog had heard about Casimir Schradog's courage. At S-F6, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
An empty jam tin became Walter "Parson" Schradog's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
Walter "Parson" Schradog found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
scrawny_ronnnie: Emil "Shadow" Ronnnie stepped off the supply cart at R-S1 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Emil "Shadow" Ronnnie walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Emil "Shadow" Ronnnie had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Valentin Hect, grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Emil "Shadow" Ronnnie answered to number 630. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Emil "Shadow" Ronnnie wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

A bullet went through Emil "Shadow" Ronnnie's upper arm at R-S1 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Henrik Davidsonmars of the Concord (@davidsonmarshall). Emil "Shadow" Ronnnie was hit at R-S1 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Henrik Davidsonmars of the Concord (@davidsonmarshall).
Marek "Lucky" Ronnnie put a lock of hair in a matchbox beside the bunk. Someone who had known Emil "Shadow" Ronnnie helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Marek "Lucky" Ronnnie had just lit a cigarette at R-S1 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Tobias Georgia of the Concord (@channel17georgia).
Marek "Lucky" Ronnnie's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Marek "Lucky" Ronnnie was hit in the foot through his boot at R-S1. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Karel "Ash" Johannmigano of the Concord (@johannmigano).
Marek "Lucky" Ronnnie lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
Marek "Lucky" Ronnnie died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
Benedikt Ronnnie took the same post at R-S1 where Marek "Lucky" Ronnnie stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
sir.jackiv.777: Walter Jackiv reached N-F2 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
Walter Jackiv saved the last of the sugar for Konrad Dooficus's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Konrad's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
A crow sat on the parapet above Walter Jackiv all afternoon. The men say it chose him.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Walter Jackiv. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.

A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Walter Jackiv as a story about a general. The ending was the same. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Jackiv. Walter Jackiv read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
souploner: The sergeant gave Clement "Ash" Souploner a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 15 or any other.
Clement "Ash" Souploner dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.
Asked what he will do after the war, Clement "Ash" Souploner said: 'Be a choir singer in Halden. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
steelhouses1: The old hands of N-F6 have been here since Day 1. Clement "Hollow" Steelhouses has been here since Day 11. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
On a quiet night Clement "Hollow" Steelhouses (Concord) and Jakub Soukup (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
Clement "Hollow" Steelhouses and Valentin Summerton have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
Someone asked Clement "Hollow" Steelhouses to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at N-F6 and grazed Clement "Hollow" Steelhouses's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Walter "Spark" Ryan of the Hegemony (@kedrik_ryan).
Clement "Hollow" Steelhouses's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at N-F6 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
A recruit asked Clement "Hollow" Steelhouses how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
v_war_daddy_v: Nobody asked Leopold Daddy why he came. Nobody in U-F5 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Gideon "Rabbit" Lacy lent Leopold Daddy a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Leopold Daddy watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Leopold Daddy found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Leopold Daddy waited for the password before answering.
Leopold Daddy raised his head for a heartbeat too long at U-F5. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Wendel Damianbarres of the Hegemony (@damianbarresi).
Leopold Daddy rejoined the squad at U-F5. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Leopold Daddy was on watch at U-F5 when the night raid hit. The men found Leopold Daddy at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Norbert "Crow" Millii of the Hegemony (@mac_a_millii).
A letter came with Rafael Daddy: "I am Leopold Daddy's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

A bullet went through Rafael Daddy's upper arm at U-F5 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Quentin Benvenuti of the Hegemony (@lelio_benvenuti). Rafael Daddy waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Rafael Daddy no longer needed it.
Severin Daddy took the same post at U-F5 where Rafael Daddy stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
wade_b_p: Bram Wade arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Bram Wade walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir. A letter from home reached Bram Wade before dusk. Bram Wade read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bram Wade did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Bram Wade fired back. Edmund "Whistle" Es was gravely wounded. Bram Wade got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 711. The men who came later will ask about it. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Bram Wade shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Bram Wade fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Marek "Tin" Zicharyafour was badly wounded.
A beetle crawled across Bram Wade's sleeve during the long wait. He could do nothing about it without giving away the position.
Bram Wade and Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner both swear they saw a ghost at the Ossuary Wood. Each says the other screamed first.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Bram Wade asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Bram Wade lay behind a dead tree trunk at R-C10 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Severin "Brick" Alsnafe was grazed.

Bram Wade had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Isidor "Owl" Askey crossed it, Bram Wade fired. Isidor "Owl" Askey was badly wounded. Bram Wade was hit through the chest at R-C10. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Jonas "Mole" Biesc of the Concord (@biesc_). A single shot at R-C10. Bram Wade sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Jonas "Mole" Biesc of the Concord (@biesc_).
Nils Wade put his mother's thimble beside the bunk. Someone who had known Bram Wade helped clear the shelf without saying why.
wellington21324: Day 8. The corporal put Dorian Wellington beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Dorian Wellington offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-S2. Dorian Wellington has learned to walk bent double.

Dorian Wellington delivered an urgent message and waited while the officer searched every pocket for a pencil to sign for it. Dorian Wellington got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 567. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Dorian Wellington kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A new trench junction cost Dorian Wellington ten minutes. On the way back, he marked the right turn with a broken spoon.
Dorian Wellington ran six messages in one night. The last one was a request for more runners.
Dorian Wellington traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
Dorian Wellington stacked spare duckboards beside the junction. Within an hour, the stack had become a bench, a table and an argument.
Dorian Wellington and Anselm Deakins made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Fog so thick that Dorian Wellington could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling.
